cooldown.binNote: Wiki 'static' 0.5 is the charge-recharge queue time gate, not the true recharge; actual recharge is {{ap|26 to 12}} per charge, matching neither bin's cooldown row (0.5) nor a listed bin recharge array.

cost.binNote: Wiki lists cost as 30 mana + 1 charge; the bin's NilahE cost value is 40. This is a genuine disagreement between the two sources; the wiki's 30 is reported here.

mechanics.claim: Nilah dashes a fixed distance in the direction of the target unit, dealing physical damage to enemies she passes through.
mechanics.quote: '''Nilah''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} a fixed distance in the direction of the target unit, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through.

mechanics.claim: Slipstream resets Nilah's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Slipstream {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nilah's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Formless Blade (Q) and Apotheosis (R) can be cast during the dash.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Formless Blade|Nilah}} and {{ai|Apotheosis|Nilah}} can be cast during the dash.

mechanics.claim: Nilah periodically stocks a Slipstream charge, up to a maximum of 2.
mechanics.quote: '''Nilah''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Slipstream'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
